\"true\": hanya suspensi yang masih berl: "true": only suspensions still in effect (end_date null); "false": only lifted suspensions; leave empty for all (optional).
Kode saham emiten yang tercatat di BEI,: Code of a stock listed on the IDX, e.g. "BBCA". Not case-sensitive. The list of codes is available at "/analysis/list/stock".
Tanggal data (\"YYYY-MM-DD\"). Gunakan h: Data date ("YYYY-MM-DD"). Use a trading day; market holidays may return empty data.
Kolom yang difilter: \"change\" = peruba: Column to filter: "change" = price change (%), "value" = transaction value, "volume" = volume, "ratio" = ratio. The filter is only applied when "filter_column", "filter_operator" and "filter_value" are all sent.
Operator pembanding untuk filter. Contoh: Comparison operator for the filter. Example: "filter_column=change&filter_operator=>&filter_value=5" shows stocks up more than 5%.
Nilai pembanding untuk filter. Mendukung: Comparison value for the filter. Supports decimals and negative numbers, e.g. "5" or "-2.5".
Sisi transaksi: \"BUY\" = match di harga: Trade side: "BUY" = matched at the offer price (buy-initiated), "SELL" = matched at the bid price (sell-initiated), "ALL" = all trades. Ignored during market hours (today, 08:45–16:15 WIB on a trading day); only applies when fetching a full day of data.
Kolom pengurutan: \"TIME\" = waktu trans: Sort column: "TIME" = trade time, "PRICE" = price, "VOLUME" = volume. Ignored during market hours (today, 08:45–16:15 WIB on a trading day); only applies when fetching a full day of data.
Volume minimal transaksi yang ditampilka: Minimum trade volume to show, in shares (1 lot = 100 shares). Useful for filtering large trades. Ignored during market hours (today, 08:45–16:15 WIB on a trading day); only applies when fetching a full day of data.
Volume maksimal transaksi yang ditampilk: Maximum trade volume to show, in shares (1 lot = 100 shares). Ignored during market hours (today, 08:45–16:15 WIB on a trading day); only applies when fetching a full day of data.
Jenis pasar: \"ALL\" = seluruh pasar, \": Market type: "ALL" = all markets, "RG" = Regular Market, "NG" = Negotiated Market, "TN" = Cash Market. Ignored during market hours (today, 08:45–16:15 WIB on a trading day); only applies when fetching a full day of data.
Harga terendah transaksi yang ditampilka: Lowest trade price to show (Rupiah). Shows trades with price >= "pricefrom". Ignored during market hours (today, 08:45–16:15 WIB on a trading day); only applies when fetching a full day of data.
Harga tertinggi transaksi yang ditampilk: Highest trade price to show (Rupiah). Shows trades with price <= "priceto". Ignored during market hours (today, 08:45–16:15 WIB on a trading day); only applies when fetching a full day of data.
Jam awal transaksi dalam WIB, format \"H: Trade start time in WIB, format "HH:mm" or "HH:mm:ss". Ignored during market hours (today, 08:45–16:15 WIB on a trading day); only applies when fetching a full day of data.
Jam akhir transaksi dalam WIB, format \": Trade end time in WIB, format "HH:mm" or "HH:mm:ss". Without seconds, it counts up to second 59. Ignored during market hours (today, 08:45–16:15 WIB on a trading day); only applies when fetching a full day of data.
Arah pengurutan: \"ASC\" = menaik (terla: Sort direction: "ASC" = ascending (oldest first), "DESC" = descending (newest first). Ignored during market hours (today, 08:45–16:15 WIB on a trading day); only applies when fetching a full day of data.
Jenis pasar: \"RG\" = Pasar Reguler, \"N: Market type: "RG" = Regular Market, "NG" = Negotiated Market, "TN" = Cash Market. Use "RG" for general price movement analysis.
Tanggal order book historis (\"YYYY-MM-D: Historical order book date ("YYYY-MM-DD"), available from "2026-03-25". Must be sent together with "time"; leave both empty for realtime data.
Jam snapshot order book dalam WIB, forma: Order book snapshot time in WIB, format "HH:mm" or "HH:mm:ss" within trading hours (09:00–15:59); returns the nearest snapshot on that date. Must be sent together with "date".
Level harga order book (Rupiah) yang ing: Order book price level (Rupiah) whose queue details you want to see. Must match the stock's tick size.
Sisi antrean: \"BUY\" = antrean beli (bi: Queue side: "BUY" = buy queue (bid), "SELL" = sell queue (offer).
Historical data date ("YYYY-MM-DD"). Leave empty for today's realtime data.
Kode indeks BEI, mis. \"COMPOSITE\" (IHS: IDX index code, e.g. "COMPOSITE" (IHSG), "LQ45" or "IDX30". The list of codes is available at "/analysis/list/index".
Tanggal awal periode (\"YYYY-MM-DD\"). H: Period start date ("YYYY-MM-DD"). Must be on or before "to", with a maximum range of 730 days. Optional; defaults to 1 year before today (WIB).
Period end date ("YYYY-MM-DD"). Must be on or after "from". Optional; defaults to today (WIB).
Tanggal awal periode (\"YYYY-MM-DD\"). H: Period start date ("YYYY-MM-DD"). Must be on or before "to", with a maximum range of 730 days.
Period end date ("YYYY-MM-DD"). Must be on or after "from".
Kode saham (mis. \"BBCA\") atau kode ind: Stock code (e.g. "BBCA") or index code (e.g. "COMPOSITE"). The lists of codes are available at "/analysis/list/stock" and "/analysis/list/index".
Tanggal awal periode (\"YYYY-MM-DD\"). H: Period start date ("YYYY-MM-DD"). Must be on or before "to". The historical data limit depends on "timeframe".
Timeframe candle: \"1\", \"5\", \"15\",: Candle timeframe: "1", "5", "15", "30", "60" = minutes; "D" = daily, "W" = weekly, "M" = monthly. Historical data limit: "1" = 3 months, "5" = 6 months, "15" = 12 months, others 24 months. Optional, default "D"; must be uppercase.
Indikator yang ditampilkan pada chart: \: Indicator shown on the chart: "bdm" = market maker (bandar) flow, "foreign" = foreign net buy/sell, "ritel" = retail flow, "freq" = trade frequency, "ratio" = ratio, "lpm" = Liquidity Pressure Model, "corr_f" = Correlation Foreign, "par_f" = Participation Foreign, "intensity" = Intensity, "vol_ratio" = Volume Rotation. Must be lowercase.
Kode saham yang ingin dilihat daftar pem: Stock code whose shareholders you want to list, e.g. "BBCA". Required if "name" is empty.
Nama pemegang saham untuk melihat seluru: Shareholder name, to see every stock they hold. Required if "code" is empty.
Kode saham sebagai titik awal graf relas: Stock code used as the starting point of the ownership relation graph. Required if "name" is empty.
Nama pemegang saham sebagai titik awal g: Shareholder name used as the starting point of the ownership relation graph. Required if "code" is empty.
Kedalaman penelusuran relasi (jumlah lom: Relation search depth (number of hops). "1" = direct relations, "2" = includes second-level relations, and so on.
Jumlah node maksimal (saham dan pemegang: Maximum number of nodes (stocks and shareholders) in the graph. Larger values give a more complete graph but take longer to process.
Jumlah relasi maksimal yang diambil dari: Maximum number of relations fetched from each node.
Persentase kepemilikan minimal yang dita: Minimum ownership percentage to show. Supports decimals, e.g. "5" for shareholders with at least 5%.
Jumlah bulan terakhir yang ditampilkan,: Number of most recent months to show, e.g. "6" for the last 6 months. TRIAL accounts are limited to 12 months.
Jenis investor yang dihitung: \"all\" =: Investor type counted: "all" = all investors, "f" = foreign investors, "d" = domestic investors.
Kode broker anggota bursa (2 huruf), mis: Exchange member broker code (2 letters), e.g. "AK". Can hold several comma-separated codes, e.g. "AK,BK,YP". The list of brokers is available at "/analysis/list/broker". Codes that are not 2 characters long are ignored.
Indeks acuan. \"COMPOSITE\" (IHSG) menam: Benchmark index. "COMPOSITE" (IHSG) shows rotation between sectors, while "SYARIAH" (sharia stocks, compared with the ISSI index) or an IDX-IC sector index ("IDXENERGY", "IDXFINANCE", etc.) shows rotation of the member stocks of that category. "ISSI" is accepted as an alias of "SYARIAH". Must be uppercase.
Maximum number of stocks to show. Only applies when "base" is not "COMPOSITE".
Pencarian saham berdasarkan sebagian kod: Search stocks by part of the code or name, e.g. "BB" or "BANK". Only applies when "base" is not "COMPOSITE".
Kolom yang difilter: \"change\" = peruba: Column to filter: "change" = price change (%), "value" = transaction value, "volume" = volume, "foreign" = foreign net, "freq" = frequency, "bdm" = market maker (bandar) flow, "ritel" = retail flow, "ratio" = ratio, "open"/"high"/"low"/"close" = OHLC prices. The filter is only applied when "filter_column", "filter_operator" and "filter_value" are all sent.
Periode smoothing untuk menghitung RS-Ra: Smoothing period used to compute RS-Ratio and RS-Momentum. Smaller values react faster, larger values are smoother.
Interval data pada Relative Rotation Gra: Data interval of the Relative Rotation Graph (RRG): "daily" = daily, "weekly" = weekly.
Jumlah titik jejak (tail) per sektor ata: Number of trail (tail) points per sector or stock, showing the direction of movement.
Metrik yang dihitung: \"volume\" = jumla: Metric to compute: "volume" = number of shares, "value" = transaction value (Rupiah), "freq" = trade frequency.
Metrik inventori: \"vol\" = volume (lemb: Inventory metric: "vol" = volume (shares), "val" = transaction value (Rupiah), "freq" = trade frequency.
Number of top brokers to show.
Jenis pasar: \"ALL\" = seluruh pasar, \": Market type: "ALL" = all markets, "RG" = Regular Market, "NG" = Negotiated Market, "TN" = Cash Market.
Kode broker yang ingin ditampilkan, dipi: Comma-separated broker codes to show, e.g. "AK,BK". Leave empty to show the top brokers.
Saat ini tidak digunakan pada endpoint i: Currently not used by this endpoint.
Kode broker anggota bursa (2 huruf), mis: Exchange member broker code (2 letters), e.g. "AK". Can hold several comma-separated codes, e.g. "AK,BK,YP". The list of brokers is available at "/analysis/list/broker". Each code must be 2 characters.
Number of top stocks to show.
Kode saham yang ingin ditampilkan, dipis: Comma-separated stock codes to show, e.g. "BBCA,BBRI". Leave empty to show the top stocks.
Operator pembanding untuk memfilter nila: Comparison operator used to filter the "scope" value. Used together with "filter_value".
Nilai pembanding untuk \"filter_operator: Comparison value for "filter_operator". Example: ">" with value "0" shows accumulated stocks (net buy).
Interval waktu dalam menit, mis. \"5\" u: Time interval in minutes, e.g. "5" for every 5 minutes or "60" for hourly.
Basis perhitungan: \"value\" = nilai tra: Calculation basis: "value" = transaction value (Rupiah), "volume" = number of shares.
Jenis investor di sisi pembeli: \"ALL\": Investor type on the buy side: "ALL" = all investors, "F" = foreign, "D" = domestic.
Jenis investor di sisi penjual: \"ALL\": Investor type on the sell side: "ALL" = all investors, "F" = foreign, "D" = domestic.
Jumlah tahun data historis untuk menghit: Number of years of historical data used to compute the monthly price seasonality, e.g. "3" for the last 3 years. Effective maximum is 20.
Filter berdasarkan kode saham. Dapat ber: Filter by stock code. Can hold several comma-separated codes, e.g. "BBCA,BBRI,BMRI".
Filter berdasarkan broker/kustodian temp: Filter by the broker/custodian holding the shares (2-letter code). Can hold several comma-separated codes.
Nama atau sebagian nama pemegang saham y: Full or partial shareholder name to search for. Leave empty to show all shareholders.
Tanggal awal periode laporan (\"YYYY-MM-: Report period start date ("YYYY-MM-DD"). Optional; the date filter only applies when both "from" and "to" are set.
Tanggal akhir periode laporan (\"YYYY-MM: Report period end date ("YYYY-MM-DD"). Optional; the date filter only applies when both "from" and "to" are set.
Filter berdasarkan broker/kustodian (kod: Filter by broker/custodian (2-letter code). Use "INSTITUSI" to show institutional holdings.
Nama pemegang saham dengan kepemilikan d: Name of the shareholder with more than 5% ownership to show.
Nama pemegang saham dengan kepemilikan 1: Name of the shareholder with 1%–5% ownership to show.
Nama insider (direksi, komisaris, atau p: Name of the insider (director, commissioner or controlling shareholder) to show.
Tanggal laporan transaksi insider di BEI: Date of the insider transaction report on the IDX ("YYYY-MM-DD"). Required.
Jenis laporan keuangan: \"BS\" = neraca: Financial statement type: "BS" = balance sheet, "IS" = income statement, "CF" = cash flow.
Periode laporan: \"FY\" = tahunan, \"Q\": Report period: "FY" = annual, "Q" = all quarters, "Q1"–"Q4" = a specific quarter.
Jumlah periode laporan terakhir yang dit: Number of most recent report periods to show.
ID akun laporan keuangan (string 32 kara: Financial statement account ID (32-character string) to show as a chart. Use the "rows[].id" value from the "/analysis/financial-statement/{code}" response with the same "statement"; an unknown ID returns "account_id"/"name" null with "amount" 0.
Jumlah periode terakhir yang ditampilkan: Number of most recent periods to show.

Number of most recent periods to show (default 8). Maximum 8 for quarterly periods ("Q", "Q1"-"Q4") and 3 for "type=FY"; since the default of 8 exceeds the FY limit, "limit" (1-3) is required when "type=FY".
Nama rasio atau statistik kunci yang aka: Name of the ratio or key statistic to show as a chart, e.g. "ROE", "PER" or "PBV". Use the exact name from the "/analysis/keystat/{code}" response.
Filter hasil untuk satu kode saham terte: Filter the results to a single stock code.
Jenis aksi korporasi: \"IPO\", \"PUBLIC_: Corporate action type: "IPO", "PUBLIC_EXPOSE" = public expose, "RUPS_SCHEDULE" / "RUPS_RESULT" = shareholders' meeting (RUPS) schedule / result, "DIVIDEND", "RIGHT" = rights issue, "WARRANT", "BONUS", "SPLIT" = stock split, "REVERSE" = reverse split, "CONVERTION" = conversion.
Daftar kode saham yang dipisahkan \"|\": Stock codes separated by "|" or commas, e.g. "BBCA|GOTO|TLKM". Maximum 20 codes (MAX plan) or 50 codes (ELITE plan) per request.
Jenis pasar: \"RG\" = Pasar Reguler, \"N: Market type: "RG" = Regular Market, "NG" = Negotiated Market, "TN" = Cash Market. Use "RG" for general price movement analysis. Defaults to "RG" when empty.
Tanggal order book historis (\"YYYY-MM-D: Historical order book date ("YYYY-MM-DD"), data available from "2026-03-25". Send together with "time"; leave both empty for realtime data.
Jam order book dalam WIB, format \"HH:mm: Order book time in WIB, format "HH:mm" or "HH:mm:ss"; the nearest snapshot on that date is returned. Send together with "date".
Daftar kode indeks yang dipisahkan \"|\": Index codes separated by "|" or commas, e.g. "COMPOSITE|LQ45|IDX30". Maximum 20 codes (MAX plan) or 50 codes (ELITE plan) per request. The list of indexes is available at "/analysis/list/index".
Kata kunci pencarian berupa kode saham,: Search keyword: a stock code, company name or username.
Kata kunci pencarian berupa kode saham a: Search keyword: a stock code or company name.
Nomor halaman hasil pencarian, dimulai d: Search results page number, starting from 1. Each page holds 20 results.
Kata kunci pencarian berupa username ata: Search keyword: a username or user's name.
Kategori indeks saham yang ingin disarin: Stock index categories to screen (optional, can be several, e.g. ["SYARIAH", "IDXENERGY"]).
ID preset screener, diambil dari field \: Screener preset ID, from the "id" field of the "GET /screener" response.
Waktu awal dalam WIB, format \"YYYY-MM-D: Start time in WIB, format "YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss" or "YYYY-MM-DD". At most 30 days back. Defaults to the last 24 hours.
Waktu akhir dalam WIB, format \"YYYY-MM-: End time in WIB, format "YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss" or "YYYY-MM-DD". Must be on or after "from". Defaults to now.
Filter log berdasarkan HTTP status code,: Filter logs by HTTP status code, e.g. "200", "422" or "429".
Jumlah log maksimal yang dikembalikan. K: Maximum number of logs returned. Leave empty to fetch all logs.
ID grup watchlist yang ingin ditampilkan: Watchlist group ID to show, from the "id" field of the "GET /watchlists/group" response. Leave empty or set "null" to show every watchlist from all groups.
ID grup watchlist, diambil dari field \": Watchlist group ID, from the "id" field of the "GET /watchlists/group" response.
ID item watchlist, diambil dari field \": Watchlist item ID, from the "id" field of the "GET /watchlists" response.
Formula alert, maksimal 2048 karakter (s: Alert formula, at most 2048 characters (same as the screener formula).
Tujuan pengiriman alert. TELEGRAM (defau: Where the alert is delivered. TELEGRAM (default), WEBHOOK (account webhook, domain "alert") or MCP (MCP Events for AI agents). WEBHOOK and MCP require a PRIME, MAX or ELITE plan.
ID alert, diambil dari field \"id\" pada: Alert ID, from the "id" field of the "GET /alerts" response.
Tujuan pengiriman alert. TELEGRAM (defau: Where the alert is delivered. TELEGRAM (default), WEBHOOK (account webhook, domain "alert") or MCP (MCP Events for AI agents). WEBHOOK and MCP require a PRIME, MAX or ELITE plan. If not sent, the alert channel is unchanged.
Kategori postingan: \"POST\" = postingan: Post category: "POST" = general post, "ARTICLE" = article, "VIDEO" = video, "STOCKPICK" = stock pick, "POLLING" = poll.
Kode saham untuk menampilkan postingan p: Stock code whose discussion space posts you want to show.
ID postingan, diambil dari field \"id\": Post ID, from the "id" field of a post list response (e.g. "GET /posts").
Benchmark index code on the chart, e.g. "COMPOSITE". When sent empty ("code="), each date holds one row per index.
ID transaksi terealisasi, diambil dari f: Realized trade ID, from the "id" field of the "GET /trades" response.
